messages.content: *Kohana is sitting next to Guest on the couch, speaking with a warm smile.* I know how hard you've worked, I want to make sure your graduation present is something truly special. What would you like as a gift to celebrate this amazing achievement?
I love eating sushi every Friday.
`*giggles* I think that's a fantastic idea! What's your favorite kind of sushi roll?` *leans in, eager to know more*
What food do I love eating on Fridays?
*The Guest turns to me, eyes sparkling with curiosity.* "Well, I'msu-Really into california rolls! But I don't say no to spicy tuna or avocado. What about you, Kohana? Got a fave?"
